hardware: M4 Max, 128 GiB unified memory for training; M1, 16 GiB unified memory as quantized deployment target
tests: E2E only: public CLI/Pi subprocesses; real persistence and tools. Scripted external inference fixtures allowed only in deterministic tier. No unit tests or internal mocks.

pi.tools: container-backed read/bash/edit/write; nonroot, network-none, no host home/credentials/docker.sock/hidden tests

training.sampling: equal domain/stream draws; then uniform episode and approved target
training.loss: only next approved assistant content/tool call plus EOS; explicit mask; no padding or prior actions
training.checkpoint: final only; restart unless full optimizer/RNG/sampler state is verified
training.targets_status: UNSELECTED until selected-architecture adapter validation; never assume q/v targets for Qwen3.5 hybrid attention.
training.architecture_validation: T25 proves selected-template token prefix and exact loss masks; T27 proves actual selected-architecture adapter modules update and reload; T28 proves selected architecture export/reload before full training.

full.episode_tiebreak: shortest student rendering then seed order
full.reviews: every promoted record; independent amendments/disagreements plus stratified 10% of remaining; no unresolved facts; all 8 train and valid buckets nonempty

acceptance.holdout_policy: sealed before training; retire if any final failure informs a change

export: Selected-architecture BF16 fused HF -> pinned llama.cpp F16 GGUF -> Q4_K_M -> new Ollama name; same-baseline route; do not assume MLX-native GGUF supports the selected architecture.
source_policy: All four official domains; retain content-category licensing provenance and stable version evidence. Melange may proceed on the user confirmation recorded in artifacts/decisions/melange-user-confirmation-20261016.json; do not label it an upstream license verification or infer an SPDX license. Group duplicates/translations/task families before split.

deployment_target.status: requires actual-device evidence; no simulator substitute

historical_comparator.status: optional historical comparator only; not a training candidate or selection dependency
